sources.articleTitle: France investigates actor Depardieu, writer Houellebecq over alleged gang rape
Gérard Depardieu and Michel Houellebecq investigated over on-set rape and assault allegations

headline: French Authorities Investigate Depardieu And Houellebecq Over Assault
seoTitle: Gérard Depardieu and Michel Houellebecq Rape Investigation
metaDescription: French police have launched an investigation into actor Gérard Depardieu and author Michel Houellebecq regarding alleged 2018 gang rape and assault claims.
aiSummaryBullets: Police in France are investigating allegations of gang rape and assault involving actor Gérard Depardieu and author Michel Houellebecq.
The events are alleged to have occurred in December 2018 during the production of the film Thalasso.
The plaintiff has also accused the film's director, Guillaume Nicloux, of complicity in the alleged abuse.
aiContextParagraph: French law enforcement officials have initiated an investigation into actor Gérard Depardieu and author Michel Houellebecq following allegations of sexual assault and gang rape. According to reports, the incident is alleged to have taken place in December 2018 while the two individuals were filming the movie Thalasso, in which they both starred as fictionalized versions of themselves. In addition to the accusations against the two public figures, the complainant has reportedly alleged that the film's director, Guillaume Nicloux, was complicit in the abuse. The investigation follows reports from sources close to the case, which highlight serious claims regarding conduct on the film's set. These allegations add to the ongoing legal scrutiny regarding the professional and personal conduct of those involved in the French film industry, specifically concerning Depardieu, who has previously faced other allegations of sexual misconduct within his career.
whyItIsViral: The story is currently covered by two independent media outlets with a moderate velocity of reportage.
